<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919556_theRebbe_605" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919556_theRebbe_605__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that all exiles are called Mitzrayim (boundary), and the journey to Yardein Yericho involves a level beyond intellect, culminating in the future redemption through Mashiach who judges by smell.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is the explanation of the verse, "And these are the journeys of the children of Israel who went out of the land of Egypt,"</t>
    <t s="2">for behold,</t>
    <t s="3">all the exiles</t>
    <t s="4">are called Mitzrayim,</t>
    <t s="5">Mitzrayim meaning a strait and boundary,</t>
    <t s="6">and until they come</t>
    <t s="7">to the Yardein of Yericho,</t>
    <t s="8">Yericho meaning scent,</t>
    <t s="9">a service that is above reason and intellect,</t>
    <t s="10">this is still a level of strait and boundary,</t>
    <t s="11">and in the future redemption through our righteous Mashiach, this level will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="12">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="13">about him, "He will not judge by the hearing of his ears, nor by the sight of his eyes, but he will smell the fear of Hashem," he smells and judges,</t>
    <t s="14">encompassing levels that are above Chochmah and Binah,</t>
    <t s="15">and until one arrives at this is the matter of the journeys.</t>
    <t s="16">And the service within the journeys is the descent of the soul and its enclothing in the strait of the body in general,</t>
    <t s="17">and in particular, during the time of the Mitzrayim (straits) of concealments and hidden things within the exiles,</t>
    <t s="18">behold, the empowerment for this comes from the aspect of "their origins,"</t>
    <t s="19">an expression like, "and like a spring of water whose waters do not fail,"</t>
    <t s="20">the root and essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="21">the Mah of the soul,</t>
    <t s="22">and through a drawing down from "their origins" to "their journeys,"</t>
    <t s="23">which is accomplished through the aspect of Moshe within each and every Jew,</t>
    <t s="24">"and Moshe wrote,"</t>
    <t s="25">the aspect of Mah is revealed also within the soul that is in the body, and through this he performs his service.</t>
    <t s="26">And the service is the journeying and elevation from below to above,</t>
    <t s="27">"their journeys" to "their origins."</t>
    <t s="28">And a verse does not depart from its simple meaning,</t>
    <t s="29">the journeys of the generation of the wilderness in the wilderness of the nations,</t>
    <t s="30">for that which a person has the ability to draw down the Mah of the soul in revelation and to overcome his body and his animal soul,</t>
    <t s="31">and especially in the time of exile and the generation of the heels of Mashiach,</t>
    <t s="32">a darkness doubled and redoubled,</t>
    <t s="33">a time of trials etc., as mentioned above,</t>
    <t s="34">is through the deeds of the Patriarchs who subdued the source of the husks by traveling and encamping in the wilderness of the nations, the serpent, the fiery serpent, and the scorpion,</t>
    <t s="35">"And it was when the Ark traveled... and Moshe said... scatter Your enemies and let those who hate You flee,"</t>
    <t s="36">therefore also the branches will be subdued afterwards by the person throughout all the generations,</t>
    <t s="37">through that which "and Moshe wrote" within each one, "their origins" to "their journeys" and "these are their journeys" to "their origins,"</t>
    <t s="38">and this is in the manner of the general and the particular,</t>
    <t s="39">until they come to the Yardein of Yericho,</t>
    <t s="40">"he smells and judges" in his service in particular,</t>
    <t s="41">and afterwards to the general redemption, the coming of our righteous Mashiach, who "will not judge by the hearing of his ears, nor will he decide by the sight of his eyes, but he will smell the fear of Hashem," he smells and judges,</t>
    <t s="42">in the future redemption that will come speedily in our days.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
